events.body:
## Context

All three READMEs clone `https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git` and then `cd BLT-Dash`, `cd BLT-Rewards` or `cd Github_Sportscaster`. The root README uses `cd BLT/<project>`.

## What to do

1. Change them to `cd BLT/blt-dash`, `cd BLT/blt-rewards` and `cd BLT/blt-gitcaster`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Commands work when pasted in order
- [ ] They match the root README

## How to test locally

```bash
Follow the steps in a temp directory.
```
